selection: All 46 first later failures from the six-call branch, all immediately rescued in p08_failure_boundary_audit_v0_1; no further filtering. Outcomes through the rescue read are exposed. No future rescued-chain outcomes are used for design.
branch_definition: Reuse the saved unrescued boundary body, capture it, then never repair.
Reuse the saved rescued boundary body, capture it, then never repair.
Start from the identical rescued body and successor packet, then repair before every future read as a maintenance control.
horizon_rationale: Equal follow-up for every selected event, using the same number of reconstruction opportunities as the preceding maintenance studies. Events near the original generation-32 endpoint are not censored early. Absolute generations extend through at most 50.
apparatus: Unchanged original exact writer applied to each branch's own final body and current injury mask; unchanged 2048-step reader, 1024 settling updates, final 32-update port means, beta=3 writer, native toroidal damage and reset. Body reset at every successor. Each branch receives its own written packet, without substituting a repaired or ancestral packet.
forcing: Use the original continuation identity and innovation namespace at each absolute generation. All branches share current injury, birth reset and positive/negative cue forcing. Ongoing positive and negative cue forcing are independent as in the source cohort. Generations beyond 32 are new deterministic realizations from these frozen stream definitions.
primary_descriptive_endpoint: Uninterrupted success over successor offsets 1 through 18, excluding the already known boundary offset 0 for all branches. Success requires all four rule-aligned cue/port means strictly above 0.25.
secondary_descriptive_endpoints: First failure offset or right censoring at 18
Uninterrupted counts at every relative offset
Paired outcomes for rescue versus no rescue and continued repair versus withdrawal
Paired outcomes by history and the exposed 20-case once-better subgroup
analysis: Counts and paired differences within these 46 selected contexts and 36 source blocks. Continue every branch after failure. No population p-values, confidence intervals, policy-efficiency claim, success threshold for a new law, or extension of the previous confirmatory sample.
interpretation: Persistence after withdrawal demonstrates finite propagation through the original writer and fresh-body reader in this selected panel. Failure immediately after rescue distinguishes current expression from successor competence. Continued-repair success alongside withdrawal failure supports ongoing maintenance dependence here. Continued-repair failure limits even that control. Supplied lattice, task apparatus and cues remain external; results do not establish autonomy, indefinite inheritance, or RDT-specific predictive advantage.
qualification: Two already observed source contexts, each replayed for native generations 16 and 17, where the original three source schedules coincide with no/no/every-read future repair. Require byte equality for incoming/prepared/outgoing packets, injury, birth, bodies, windows, means, margins and pass flags. Test own-successor linkage, strict threshold, recovery versus uninterrupted success, opposite task, and continued execution after failure with small deterministic checks.
independent_audits: Independently construct every injury mask, every writer capture and every future repair; independently solve all 828 future repair optimizations; separately replay all 2484 future reads with flat dynamics. Recount saved windows and endpoints separately before COMPLETE.
runtime: Benchmark only the already exposed qualification contexts. Forecast 828 future context steps using the slower measured step times, a factor of 1.5 and 60 seconds overhead. One process and one numerical thread within the shared 12-CPU limit. Detach if forecast exceeds 600 seconds, preserve log/PID/frozen inputs/status, and do not poll scientific progress automatically.
